_comment: THROWAWAY control manifest for leg BASE - the NEGATIVE half. Byte-identical to manifest_model.json except that no top-level 'model' key exists. This is the cell that proves the model passthrough can be absent: if a --model flag appears in a launch line resolved from this manifest, the passthrough is emitting a default rather than passing through, and the control fails.
_base_note: Top-level 'base' is display-only (orchestrate.ps1 prints it in the banner). It is NOT the per-leg base under test. Set to a nonsense value on purpose: if the per-leg resolution ever fell back to the manifest field, this string would appear in a resolved worktree line and the control would fail loudly.
